name: Takadanobaba
tagline: Shinjuku in 7 minutes and Shibuya in 15 minutes. Served by 3 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, where JR East, Seibu and Tokyo Metro run 3 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 15 minutes to Otemachi, 7 minutes to Shinjuku, 15 minutes to Shibuya and 36 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. The station stands 21.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 18.9 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 21.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 11.7 m to 30.6 m, a difference of 18.9 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 4 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: ピーコックストア 高田馬場

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 14 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 大同病院, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is JCHO 東京山手メディカルセンター, about 17 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 3 lines serve the station. JR Yamanote Line and Seibu Shinjuku Line run through it. Tokyo Metro Tozai Line also call here. The lines are split between operators (JR East runs 1 line, Seibu runs 1 line and Tokyo Metro runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Tozai Line runs at 160% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 木場→門前仲町, which this station is not on. Seibu Shinjuku Line runs at 148% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 下落合→高田馬場, which includes this station. JR Yamanote Line runs at 136%. Its busiest stretch is 新大久保→新宿, which this station is likewise not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: One room ¥90,000 to ¥100,000, 1K ¥110,000 to ¥120,000, 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥260,000 to ¥270,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥90,000 to ¥100,000. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Nishi-Waseda is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet, but Takadanobaba is ahead on the number of lines and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It takes 12 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Takadanobaba.

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 3 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: 3 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are among the lowest in the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
